newsitem.title: USA: ABR Info falls on momentum selling.
newsitem.headline: ABR Info falls on momentum selling.

text.p: The stock of ABR Information Services Inc, which has been on a month-long roller coaster, fell nine to 47 on Monday as momentum players sold the issue a few days after a top executive was removed, traders said.
"It had a dead-cat bounce, and in the last couple of days sellers have moved in," said one trader.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.

On Nov 13, the company announced its board removed Vincent Addonosio as executive vice president due to business differences. The company, which provides healthcare benefits services to employers, also said it named Reva Maskewitz as acting chief financial officer.
Shares dropped from $65 on Nov 12 to $54 the next day, when the company made the announcement. The following day the stock closed up $4.25 to $58.25.
The stock hit an all-time high of $75.50 on Oct 8 and has fallen about 34 percent since then.
